title: Ex-Mattel executive Krista Lee Berger takes global marketing role at Clinique
summary: The Estée Lauder Companies has appointed Krista Lee Berger as Senior Vice President, Global Marketing, Clinique. In this role, Berger will lead Clinique's global marketing strategy, drive breakthrough innovation and strengthen the brand's cultural relevance through modernized communications, the group said. title: Study flags prenatal neurodevelopmental risks from phthalates and bisphenols
summary: Prenatal exposure to certain chemicals, including phthalates and bisphenols, may affect children's cognitive development, according to an INSERM study published on October 20. The researchers are calling for stricter regulations on these substances. title: L'Entropiste indulges in olfactory decadence with Festin
summary: The young perfume house L'Entropiste unveils Festin, a new fragrance created by Bertrand Duchaufour. Built around notes of blackberry, caviar, truffle, shagreen leather, and oud, the composition continues the house's exploration of opulent, uncompromising perfumery, where order emerges from chaos. title: Motion Equity Partners takes over microfluidics specialist Capsum
summary: Chanel has found a buyer for Capsum, in which it had held a majority stake since the 2010s. On Tuesday, October 20, investment fund Motion Equity Partners officially announced its acquisition of a majority stake in the company, which specializes in the formulation of high-end skincare, makeup and fragrances.
